description: UFO arc part 2/3: the code from Lucia's dream opens a restricted-area door, then a look back at the dream (portal, eggs, Earth), payoff first. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-ufo2/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-ufo2.mp4): four pieces of stream-2316-0014.mp4 (stream #5 hour 5, file t 0 = 23:16 WIB) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined: h5 t2515-2529, t1500-1508, t1613-1621, t1685.5-1692.5. Cuts: A t 2516.50-2522.40 = local 1.50-7.40 -> output 0.00-5.90; A t 2523.90-2528.20 = local 8.90-13.20 -> output 5.90-10.20; B t 1502.00-1506.25 = local 16.00-20.25 -> output 10.20-14.45; C t 1614.10-1619.20 = local 23.10-28.20 -> output 14.45-19.55; D t 1686.60-1691.70 = local 31.10-36.20 -> output 19.55-24.65. Beats: opens on the payoff (h5 41:56, 23:57 WIB): the 'Restricted area' keypad door, the phone note shows 3241, Windah: 'tiga dua empat satu, gue dapet note, dari mana gue dapet notenya? wait a minute, dari mana gue dapet kode itu? ... kode yang di alien, di mimpi, guys'; then the dream (Lucia asleep, h5 24:45-33:40) in three beats: the black portal 'lubang' (25:04), the egg hall 'jangan lari, kalau lari dia marah telurnya' (26:54), the solar-system room and Earth zoom 'bumi bumi bumi ... rumah siapa tuh?' (28:07). Word timings from short VAD runs (the hour transcripts drift by up to ~10 s). Outside the cuts: h5 41:45 'anjir', the 41:42-41:56 basement walk, the 'Uranus/meganus' line (h5 28:01), 'oh s**t' at h5 27:13, Lucia in a bra top at h5 24:20-24:45 and 33:50-34:25. In the dream Lucia wears a white tee and light trousers (checked on brightened frames). Frames: basement door, dream void, eggs, planets, Earth; no guns, no gore, no drugs. Main 24.65 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,538) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'KODE DARI MIMPI LUCIA', line 2 Volt 'TERNYATA BUKA PINTU', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
